root_cause.text: The `rx_complete` function in the `cdc-phonet` driver lacks a bounds check on `skb_shinfo->nr_frags` before calling `skb_add_rx_frag`, allowing a malicious device to overflow the `frags[]` array with excessive full-page bulk transfers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the `else` block in `rx_complete` to add a condition `if (skb_shinfo(skb)->nr_frags < MAX_SKB_FRAGS)` before invoking `skb_add_rx_frag`, whereas the original code executed this function unconditionally; the CVE description explicitly states a malicious device can overflow the array by sending an "unbounded sequence of full-page bulk transfers."

vuln_statements.content:
for (i = 0; i < skb_shinfo(skb)->nr_frags; i++)
		skb_add_rx_frag(skb, i, page, offset, len, gfp);

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause, this loop iterates over all fragments without bounds checking against the frags[] array size. The lack of validation on skb_shinfo->nr_frags allows a malicious device to send excessive full-page bulk transfers, causing the frags[] array to overflow when skb_add_rx_frag is called for each fragment.
